whatChanged: Server package: the live install no longer fails in iptables. The scope (-i) is applied only to FORWARD; the nat POSTROUTING MASQUERADE rule no longer carries an input interface.
Server package: status and the statistics timer skip tunnel interfaces that do not exist yet (IPv6-only hosts), instead of failing every 30 s with 'Command failed: wg'.
Version 0.24.0+5017; Android installs in place over 0.23.1 (same signer, same package names).
Landing page rebuilt: features, five transports, IPv4/IPv6, install and administration instructions, bilingual README with diagrams.
